name: validate_profile
description: Validate a Dynamic Profiles JSON document (families/instances/nodedefs/editors/linkdefs) by parsing it with nucore's own profile loader. Returns any structural problems found (missing ids, dangling editor references, malformed properties/commands) so they can be fixed before installing the plugin. Does not touch the hub -- purely local validation. Call this any time a candidate profile is shared or generated, not just when something looks wrong.

profile.description: The raw Dynamic Profiles JSON document to validate, as returned by/sent to polyglot.getJsonProfile()/updateJsonProfile().
